item.title: PortWin 1.23
item.description:
• Video in Windows programs works again: MP4 (H.264) and WMV cutscenes failed to open because the video libraries weren’t found. System Check now plays test videos.
  • Voice chat: Windows programs can use the Mac’s microphone and camera (Discord, Teams, Zoom, in-game voice). System Check shows the microphone permission.
  • Crackle-free sound in every program: the Mac’s speakers switch to 48 kHz while Windows programs run, then back.
  • New bottles no longer ask which graphics engine to use — PortWin picks it (D3DMetal for DirectX 12 games when connected).
  • Bottle settings: frame-rate limit (60 / 30 fps to save battery) and MetalFX upscaling for DirectX 10–11 games.
  • OpenAL and DirectMusic are detected and installed automatically when a game needs them; System Check now also checks gamepads.
